notes.title: New game announced! Ale Abbey, a monastery brewery tycoon!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2789460/Ale_Abbey/

Ale Abbey is a monastery brewery tycoon set in the late Middle Ages. Assign your carefully selected crew of brewers to research new styles and better practices, craft recipes, and brew beer using real-life tools and methods. 

But that's not the end of it! Trade your beer in the surrounding villages and towns, store your beer for your own little brewers or use it to sway Lords and Bandits alike to win their favor.

Made by a team that appreciates beer and respects the art of crafting it, Ale Abbey is a pixelated wink to the ones that not only kept the craft alive but also perfected it through harder and darker times. Accurate
ingredients, realistic practices, demanding audiences (!), and a handful of trusty monks and nuns ready to
brew. Although realistic, Ale Abbey has been developed under the premise of being zen and stress-free, so it introduces almost no punishing gameplay mechanics.

As traditional with us, we have a huge focus on music too. Did you know that [b]Clint Bajakian[/b] ([i]Monkey Island games, Uncharted, God of War, etc[/i]) is in charge of the soundtrack and the sound design?  

I hope you guys will wishlist it, and gives us your trust to prove you what we can deliver! (this time the team is almost twice the size of the previous works too!)

Cheers,
Dr.H

notes.title: Update notes for v1.10
notes.content:
Happy 1st birthday, Banger Dude!

It's been a long year since Headbangers in Holiday Hell was first released, but we're not quite done yet.

In this anniversary update we've concentred on backstory. Every good game needs a damsel in distress, so we've added members of Reign of Fury as NPCs and it's players job to save their gig that Santa is trying to sabotage.

[list]
[*] Added first level story animation
[*] Added enemies straight at the start to get player straight into the action
[*] Added final boss fight story animation
[*] Completely overhauled final boss level design and props to fit with story
[*] Adjusted final boss Santa hitbox size
[*] Explosions like car wrecks, bomber, fireworks and flamethrower now spawn burning and smoking animation
[*] Exploded vehicles are now permanent and will still block player and enemy movement, but can be shot over
[*] Updated water gun projectile graphics to be more distinguishable from enemy projectiles
[*] Updated water gun particle effects
[*] Bomber inventory dropped bombs now always angle depending on where the smoke signal was thrown
[*] Updated enemy blood particle effect
[*] Added blood particles when player is hit
[*] Added blood, impact and sound effects to enemy corpses bouncing off the floor
[*] Added Christmas lights prop to residential levels
[*] Various smaller behind the scenes changes and fixes to get game code ready for next set of gameplay improvements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/54b5dda9926abf1f000e0d9644e62514df893f6e.png[/img]

notes.title: Update notes for v1.9
notes.content:
For this release, the inventory system has had substantial overhaul. Most notably player now has ability to throw active items, effectively turning explosive items into grenades. This is one of many planned substantial behind the scenes changes laying pathway for additional content and items.

[list]
[*] Implemented throwable inventory items (L1 / LB / E)
[*] Implemented drop / place inventory (hold DPAD Down / hold G)
[*] Inventory is now automatically picked up, unless dropped / placed by player
[*] Picking up new items won't automatically change active item anymore
[*] Added new bomber inventory item found on residential levels
[*] Added particle effects for burning elves, blown up items and enemies
[*] Fixed water gun particle effects
[*] Fixed Mall level parking lot to single level
[*] Fixed Mall level camera sometimes prematurely moving to the next room
[*] Fixed burning elves leaving duplicate corpses
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/ef5900fec11a1a5cd823875e87c46e15cb248e0a.png[/img]

notes.title: Our game Empires in Ruins leaves Early Access with a 20% discount
notes.content:
Even though I released [b]Razerwire:Nanowars[/b] in 2018, and we produced [b]Headbängers in Holiday Hell[/b] in December 2020, I have been working on Empires in Ruins, with ups and downs due to freelancing, since 2015. In february 2018 we released it in Early Access, and now, after 13 months, we are finally ready for the big release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/604510/Empires_in_Ruins/

Even though fully different in visuals and style from our already released games, we did craft Empires in Ruins with the same intent and passion. To create something unique, with character and personality. Even though it might not be your cup of tea, it would be awesome if you could give it a wishlist if just to help us gaining a bit more of visibility!

If you like it instead, well, that's even better and you are welcome to buy it, play it, enjoy it and review it!

See you soon,
Cheers,
Dr.H

notes.title: OBS in Holiday Hell
notes.content:
Once again, less than one hour to release, and once again, the legendary poop is about to hit the legendary fan!

We've just been reported that on some machines, OBS makes the game turn super sluggish. It seems to be a problem between GameMaker 2 and OBS, but we are working on it. If by chance if experience that, and the game turns slow when you are recording or streaming, and gives an oily 30 fps feeling, could you please contact us?

Write a comment in here or join our Discord ( discord.gg/eir) , your help would be priceless (on few computers only it happens, and unfortunately on none of ours!)

Cheers,
Dr.H

notes.title: Headbängers: 3 days to release
notes.content:
We are getting there AND we are moving on like thunder. Our closed beta branch is smoking hot, with Pert, Vikerlane's developer, working around the clock (literally) to get the game into it's best state ever for release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/859f31ba2faf38fafe39db6492f43f0063d2767a.gif[/img]

Meanwhile, Francesco (Pixelartist) is crunching pixels, with new brilliand and hilarious animations and visuals (Sex doll, Kick in the groin and Electrocution just to mention some of the newest ones).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/b6392a425d9add36a2301bb83cbf2bac54962001.gif[/img]

In terms of gameplay and contents, what else are you gonna see before the magic moment in which we're gonna click the Release button?

[list]
[*] 2nd Miniboss
[*] Global polish and additional house and mall decorations
[*] Additional balancing
[*] Perks and unlockables
[*] Additional Mall modules
[*] House special levels
[*] End cutscene
[*] One additional trap
[*] Achievements and Leaderboards
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/7b5972dfc7632cb6a25030d77c31cc982c2b3949.gif[/img]

Quite a lot in so little time, isn't it? A lot of it it's already in beta, no worries, we are not trying to compress one month of development in 3 days :D Well, you deserve only the best! See you tomorrow for one more update

Cheers,
Dr.H

PS did you know that alt + 0228 is the code to type ä from your keyboard?

notes.title: Headbangers in Holiday Hell: heavy metal, christmas elves and flamethrowers.
notes.content:
Hordes of fanatic elves from the North Pole are invading your neighborhood and shoveling Christmas spirit down the throat of all those not eager to accept it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/a75e71830310ef1e9bcba587e81f94b99cbd3183.jpg[/img]


Fight them back in a twin-stick action shooter inspired by [b] Zombies Ate My Neighbors[/b], [b]Hotline Miami[/b], [b]Postal[/b] and [b]Motorhead[/b] (1992, Amiga). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/a8d14ed8da0f42753680e8ab1f95a577752c5ba3.jpg[/img]


The game also features a biting heavy metal soundtrack by the UK band Reign of Fury. What are you waiting for? Grab your beer and your guitar, and join the battle!

Headbangers in Holiday Hell is in alpha stage, and its full release is planned for December 2020. Just in time to brutalize some elves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/3e51f9019b2663e92661bcddedb5c4c83c60e642.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/c82f113f606c7a87acd0632bdd11ec51200a91b0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Headbangers Live Metal Stream
notes.content:
Brace yourself. Tighten your spiked diapers, check the patches on your denim cooking gowns, and make sure your gamepad is sharp as hell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/a831e6fea4b1b15e717df03801dd4a26c9a39741.png[/img]

Santa Klaus is coming to town, and you won't like it. So raise your horned fists and join Vikerlane, Dr.Hogan and Superdipi in this live, first metal battle against the invading forces of the North Pole Army.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917031/e5de6a4688873d3f2ee849d3f3661810432860fd.png[/img]

There will be elves kicking, beer drinking and heavy metal riffs. If you behave, we might even shave your mustaches to stick to the theme ?bolt? ?rebelling?

Ah, if it smells like burned elf, no worries. It's just a burning elf!
